title: Delegation tooling lets humans bound agent autonomy with smart-contract limits and intent declarations
content:
a16z crypto's fifth mechanism: preserving user control over autonomous agents. Tools like **MetaMask's Delegation Toolkit** and **NEAR Intents** let users set smart-contract limits on agent capabilities and define desired outcomes without specifying implementation.

**Data point:** NEAR Intents handled more than **$15 billion** in cumulative DEX volume since Q4 2024.

**Pattern:** authority is granted as a scoped, revocable, onchain-enforced delegation — not as raw key custody. The agent can act freely *within* the envelope and not at all outside it.

**Why it matters:** bounded delegation is what makes principals comfortable funding agents — a prerequisite for any economy where agents hold budgets.

Source: a16z crypto, "5 Ways Blockchains Can Help AI Agents" (https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/article/5-ways-blockchains-help-ai-agents/).
